title: RecordImage
description: Image of a golden record (customer, product, vendor…). Set only through an approved change request. After approval the service downloads the source link once (https only; no private, loopback or link-local addresses), accepts PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 5 MB (no SVG), re-encodes it without metadata and serves its own copy from the media store; the record never points at the outside site.

url.description: Repo.io media store address of the stored copy.

sourceUrl.description: Link the requester gave; kept for audit only.
